name: Aristocrats / Sacrifice
summary: Sac outlets, death-trigger payoffs, drains, and recursion that close through incremental life loss.
_status_note: Live recipe — Gate 3 approved 2026-05-14 by local-board via comment b74d46ce. 20/20 = 100% canon recall validated empirically against Scryfall API.

death_drain_payoffs.intent: Cards that drain opponents / gain you life whenever a creature dies.
queries: f:commander o:"another creature" o:dies o:loses o:life
f:commander o:"creature you control dies" o:loses o:life

sac_outlets.intent: Free or low-mana repeatable sacrifice outlets.

token_engines_for_fodder.intent: Repeating token producers (upkeep-trigger or death-trigger) that supply fodder.
queries: f:commander o:"beginning of" o:upkeep o:create o:"creature token" mv<=4
f:commander o:"creature you control dies" o:create o:"creature token"

self_recursion_creatures.intent: Creatures that return themselves from graveyard — repeatable death-trigger fuel.
queries: f:commander t:creature o:"return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield"

drain_wincons.intent: Game-closing drains that scale with mana or game state.
queries: f:commander o:"each opponent loses x life"

aristocrats_commanders.intent: Canonical aristocrats commanders across the three idioms (death-trigger payoff, sacrifice payoff, death-trigger doubler).
queries: is:commander o:"another creature you control dies"
is:commander o:"creature dying" o:"triggers an additional time"

wildcard.intent: Intentionally broad sweep — catches new printings whose oracle text doesn't match the precise sub-recipes above. High noise, run sparingly.

canon_recall.note: wildcard is not validated against canon — it exists to surface oddities the precise queries miss

excludes._note: Spliced into every sub-recipe query at runtime for decks tagged asymmetric_only:true. Optional otherwise.

runtime_semantics.color_identity_splice: Append `id<=<deck color identity>` per query at runtime.
runtime_semantics.decklist_exclusion: Post-fetch — filter out any name already in decklist or candidates.json top-50.
